about.title: Amr Ali is a prominent public contracting and construction company.
about.lead: We have provided you with high quality professional work in our work field such as construction, contracting, decoration and cladding for years in Saudi Arabia and Egypt.
about.approachBody: Amr Ali Co. offers a wide range of technical and project management solutions, which include engineering, procurement, construction (EPC), commissioning services. Our specialization is in interior design, construction of Buildings, Civil, Electromechanical, Infrastructure, Alominum cladding,Temporary facility and Facility Management Services to our public and private infrastructure and manufacturing sectors.

sectors.title: Engineering permanent solutions for seven vital sectors
sectors.sub: From deep foundation pour to architectural final hand-over, we translate blueprints into enduring public and private spaces. Our specialized teams match rigorous engineering precision with structural utility.

residential.title: Residential Development
residential.body: Custom turnkey villas, smart luxury compounds, and architectural masterpieces designed for premium generational living.

commercial.title: Commercial & Administrative
commercial.body: Turnkey grade-A corporate towers, modern workspaces, and corporate headquarters built for collaboration and energy efficiency.

industrial.title: Industrial & Logistics
industrial.body: State-of-the-art warehouses, factories, and heavy infrastructure built to precise technical, logistics, and seismic load requirements.

t1.review: From the initial agreement through to delivery, Amr Ali’s team was committed to every detail and deadline, and the execution matched exactly what we had agreed upon.
t1.author: Ahmed Mahmoud

t2.review: Working with the team was very smooth, and the continuous follow-up made every stage of the project clear and easy.
t2.author: Mohamed Sameh

t3.review: What I liked most was the attention to detail and the quality of the finishes; the final result was better than we expected.
t3.author: Karim Adel

t4.review: A professional engineering team that quickly resolves any challenges arising during execution, with a clear commitment to quality workmanship.
t4.author: Omar Hassan
